environment_note: Executed via search_web over open academic web repositories (arXiv, OpenReview, ACL Anthology, PMLR), publisher portals (ACM DL, Springer, Nature), and semantic citation indices (no closed Scopus or Web of Science bulk API exports). Our systematic protocol transparently frames retrieval as a PRISMA-governed open-web query- and snowball-seeded review, discloses targeted system-name specializations in S02/S05/S09, and appends remediation waves S12-S13.
